title: A Quadratic Lower Bound for Fourier RIP with Tree-Structured Sparsity
abstract: Lean 4 formalization of an explicit lower bound for uniformly row-subsampled discrete Fourier transforms acting on canonical binary-heap tree-sparse vectors. With constant distortion, at least half of frequency sequences violate tree-RIP when 20000 m <= k min(k, log_2(N/k)), with an explicit quadratic corollary. The proof uses broom supports, Fejer-kernel concentration, simultaneous Diophantine approximation, and finite counting. A full-DFT isometry theorem checks the normalization and nonvacuity of the definitions.
